class.name: riptide_control/JointPdController
class.description: Joint-space PD (effort) hold controller: commands per-joint torque to hold a target configuration against gravity. Baseline for the Riptide control stack and the simplest end-to-end demonstration of torque control.

class.name: riptide_control/EeStabilizationController
class.description: Task-space EE-stabilization controller: reads the arm joints + floating-base sensor, assembles a RobotState, and delegates to a swappable IControlLaw plugin (Pinocchio-backed dynamics). Rejects base disturbances at the EE.
